purpose: Reviewer-requested development-tuned compact CNN reference; exploratory extension after previous tests were examined
architecture: Existing SmallCNN, 16647 parameters; native 28x28 RGB; no external pretraining
selection: For each seed, choose the larger best tuning macro F1 across two learning rates; exact ties choose lower learning rate. Calibration is excluded from all candidate fitting and selection; fit temperature only for selected candidate.
uncertainty: Separate across-partition SD and conditional paired lesion bootstrap; no confirmatory superiority claim
